descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18

思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S23 「对带开关的 All Residents、Today's Visits、扫描面板、Add Resident 和 dashboard 跑 axe」 axe on All Residents with toggles, Today's Visits, the scan sheet, Add Resident and the dashboard

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 1；TFA-92587 How it works 1）
  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 4；TFA-92587 How it works 4）
  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 3；TFA-92587 How it works 3）
  • U6 'In Today' drives the dashboard counts: the Nursing Home Rounding Dashboard counts only the residents marked In Today. (The dashboard tabs and whether the counts follow the tab are TC-20 U3, gated on …（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 6；TFA-92587 How it works 6；TFA-92598 AC 4 (same rule)）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture, Nursing Home

When Run axe on /snf (Today's Visits and the All Residents tab), the resident-list scan sheet (empty and with mocked results), the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet, /snf/add and /snf/dashboard

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations. Each toggle has an accessible name that identifies its resident and exposes its on/off state

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core: zero serious or critical violations (visual-checks.ts). Expected findings to look for: nested-interactive (the toggle button inside the card's role=button) and toggles all named '+ Today' / 'In Today ✓' with no resident name

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa；TFA-92598 in progress

读屏用户只听到一串一样的「+ Today」按钮，不知道是哪个住户、是否已选；扫描和重复住户弹窗的关闭按钮没有名字；每个页面都有对比度不达标。

A screen-reader user hears a row of identical '+ Today' buttons with no resident name and no on/off state. The scan and duplicate sheets have an unnamed close button, and text contrast fails on every screen.

依据：allure cb520904, visual lane: 0 of 27 judged checks passed across desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. The toggle sits inside the card's role=button (nested-interactive) and has no aria-pressed. TC-09 risks predicted this, and the S23 oracle names it.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

The scan and duplicate sheets add an unnamed close (X) button; contrast fails on every screen.
